<div class="card-body">
'''Leia''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レイア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Leia-PSA-99569924.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">オルデランの総督兼第一議長の養女。若くして政治的な<u>リーダー</u>となる。皇帝の勅令の非道さに反発して、反乱軍に加わった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Leia.

'''Lore:'''
Adopted daughter of Alderaan’s governor and first chairman. She became a political leader at a young age. She joined the Rebellion in opposition to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore refers to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Leia (Jedi Pack)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
